description: Fetches /.well-known/security.txt and reports Contact and Expires (RFC 9116). Returns { domain, present, hasContact, expires, expired }: whether security.txt exists, has a Contact and has expired. Price: 2 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

domain.description: Public domain name, e.g. example.com; IP literals and private suffixes (.local, .internal, .lan, .corp) are refused.

name: security-txt
title: security.txt check
